label: Quaternius Universal Base Characters
qualityReason: Rigged humanoid base models with game-ready topology, hairstyles, customizable appearance, and glTF support. This is the correct foundation for actual character designs instead of locally generated shape placeholders.
intakeNotes: Use as the first character-base import. Recolor and kitbash for Aether Reliquary lineages; keep source license proof and imported GLB manifest entries.

label: Quaternius Modular Character Outfits - Fantasy
qualityReason: Fantasy outfit parts designed for modular character assembly, including rig-friendly topology, texture variations, and glTF/FBX runtime formats.
intakeNotes: Use for Wardbreaker, Relicweaver, Ashrunner, Oathblade, and city faction armor silhouettes. Prefer standard/free pack contents unless the operator explicitly chooses optional paid supporter files.

label: Quaternius Universal Animation Library
qualityReason: Retargetable humanoid locomotion and combat animation library, suitable for moving from static art to real playable characters.
intakeNotes: Map walk, jog, idle, combat, hit, death, and interaction clips into Phaser/Three preview experiments before broad runtime dependence.

label: Quaternius Fantasy Props MegaKit
qualityReason: Large fantasy prop set with weapons, potions, books, chests, market props, and blacksmith/wizard objects already in game-ready formats.
intakeNotes: Use for low-tech hand weaponry, loot pedestal dressing, forge quarters, market stalls, and inventory item renders.

label: Quaternius RPG Character Pack
qualityReason: Older but immediately useful rigged fantasy character pack for NPC/enemy proof while the modular base/outfit lane is assembled.
intakeNotes: Use only if format conversion is clean. Prefer the newer universal base/outfit packs for the playable hero.

label: Kenney Fantasy Town Kit
qualityReason: CC0 fantasy city kit candidate for the 12-city world plan, especially as a fast route to non-placeholder towns and districts.
intakeNotes: Verify exact downloaded archive contents before committing; Kenney asset pages include license files and CC0 posture.

label: Kenney Modular Dungeon Kit
qualityReason: CC0 modular dungeon assets can replace procedural reliquary shapes with real environment pieces.
intakeNotes: Use for The First Reliquary, catacombs, vault doors, stone floors, stairs, pillars, and boss rooms.

label: Poly Haven CC0 PBR Materials and HDRIs
qualityReason: CC0 HDRIs, textures, and some models for replacing flat colors with real stone, brass, leather, cloth, and lighting.
intakeNotes: Downsample aggressively for browser use; keep texture sizes budgeted and prefer KTX2/WebP after optimization.

label: ambientCG CC0 PBR Materials
qualityReason: CC0 materials and texture maps for stone, bronze, cloth, leather, ground, and ruins.
intakeNotes: Use for texture passes on imported 3D packs; do not commit high-resolution raw maps without browser-size optimization.

label: OpenGameArt Per-Asset Checked Sources
qualityReason: Useful for optional music, sound, and one-off art, but quality and license vary by asset.
intakeNotes: Reject NC, ND, SA, unknown, missing attribution, or unclear provenance. Only CC0 or fully attributed CC-BY can enter the runtime manifest.
